TP-Link Jetstream (TL-SG3452P) As Alternative to Aruba Instant On
Hey everybody!

I'm helping a friend get some real networking gear into a small business he just purchased.

I've determined that we're going to need a 48-port PoE switch.  PoE will be used to power \~4 IP phones, DECT repeater and base station, WAPs, and ultimately 12+ cameras.  Then we'll need several workstations, printer, on-site server (pfSense, in-store media streaming, WAPs management, etc.), and a few other things.

Given this is a pretty small operation at this time, I prefer to not get into expensive subscription management hardware (i.e. Cisco, Meraki, etc.).

After researching several options (Aruba, Ubiquiti, MikroTik, TP-Link, Netgear, Engenius, Zyxel), I settled on the Aruba Instant 1930 48-port PoE (JL686A) as a good option.

[https://buy.hpe.com/us/en/networking/switches/fixed-port-web-managed-ethernet-switches/aruba-1900-switch-products/aruba-instant-on-1930-switch-series/aruba-instant-on-1930-48g-class4-poe-4sfp-sfp-370w-switch/p/JL686A](https://buy.hpe.com/us/en/networking/switches/fixed-port-web-managed-ethernet-switches/aruba-1900-switch-products/aruba-instant-on-1930-switch-series/aruba-instant-on-1930-48g-class4-poe-4sfp-sfp-370w-switch/p/JL686A)

However, I can't find any in stock (probably COVID)...even the 24-port 195W PoE model isn't in stock.  No indication of when/if one will become available and I need to have a switch within the next month or so.

So now I'm looking at a possible alternative.  I'm considering a TP-Link Jetstream 48-port PoE model (TL-SG3452P).  Anyone have any experience with this switch with regards to reliability, ease of management, etc?  I haven't found anything too scathing about this specific model.  Found one thing saying they use a non-standard VLAN implementation, but haven't looked into that too much yet.

[https://www.tp-link.com/us/business-networking/poe-switch/tl-sg3452p](https://www.tp-link.com/us/business-networking/poe-switch/tl-sg3452p/)

TLDR: Am I going to regret using a TP-Link Jetstream (TL-SG3452P) in a small business setting?
